xwikidoc.content: {{velocity output="false"}} #macro(generateDisplayEditLink $displayEditLink $changeDoc) #if ("$!displayEditLink" == 'true') #set ($xredirect = "$doc.getURL('view')") #set ($hrefAttribute = "$changeDoc.getURL('edit', ""xredirect=$xredirect"")") #set ($editText = $services.localization.render('edit')) #set ($iconHTML = $services.icon.renderHTML('pencil')) #set ($displayEditLinkMarkup = "{{html clean='false'}}${iconHTML}$editText{{/html}}") #else #set ($displayEditLinkMarkup = '') #end #end ## The label of the link towards a change page, shared by the displayers that only summarise a change. It is ## emitted into the label part of a link, so it is escaped: a translation carrying wiki syntax would otherwise ## close the link and have the rest of its value parsed on its own. #set ($moreDetailsLabel = $services.rendering.escape( $services.localization.render('releasenotes.changes.display.moreDetails'), 'xwiki/2.1')) ## Loads what the displayers show of one change, so that a displayer only decides where each part goes. Sets: ## - $changeDoc, $changeObject: the change page and its ChangeClass object ## - $title: the title, escaped since the displayers emit it as wiki syntax; empty when the change has none ## - $displayEditLinkMarkup: the link towards the editor of the change, empty unless $displayEditLink is 'true' ## - $summaryEditLinkMarkup: that same link when the change has no title, empty otherwise. A change with no title ## is given no heading, since a heading holding no text at all would leave an empty section in the release note ## and an empty entry in the table of contents the release note template displays; the edit link then follows ## the summary, the only thing that displays such a change. ## - $changeSummary: the summary, displayed through the change document so that its rich text is rendered in the ## context of that document rather than of the displayer, the way the change's own page renders it. Not quiet: ## a page with no ChangeClass object keeps displaying the call itself, as the displayers always did ## - $moreDetailsLinkMarkup: the link towards the change page when the change has a description that the summary ## alone doesn't carry, empty otherwise #macro(loadChangeView $changeItem $displayEditLink) #set ($changeDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($changeItem)) #set ($changeObject = $changeDoc.getObject('ReleaseNotes.Code.Change.ChangeClass')) #generateDisplayEditLink($displayEditLink, $changeDoc) #set ($title = $services.rendering.escape("$!changeObject.getValue('title')", 'xwiki/2.1')) #set ($summaryEditLinkMarkup = '') #if ($title == '') #set ($summaryEditLinkMarkup = $displayEditLinkMarkup) #end #set ($changeSummary = "$changeDoc.display('summary', 'view', $changeObject)") #set ($moreDetailsLinkMarkup = '') #if ("$!changeObject.getValue('description')" != '') #set ($moreDetailsLinkMarkup = "[[${moreDetailsLabel}>>doc:$changeDoc.documentReference]]") #end #end #macro(displayScreenshots $changeObject $useGallery $alwaysDisplayScreenshots) #set ($mediaReferences = $changeObject.getValue('screenshots')) #if ("$!mediaReferences" == '' && $alwaysDisplayScreenshots) #set ($mediaReferences = $services.model.serialize($services.model.resolveAttachment('no_image_thumb.png', ${xcontext.macro.doc.documentReference}), 'default')) #end #if ("$!mediaReferences" != '') #set ($videoFormats = ['webm', 'mp4']) #set ($screenshotReferences = []) #set ($videoReferences = []) #foreach($mediaReference in $mediaReferences.split('\s*,\s*')) ## Make sure we have an absolute reference #if (!$mediaReference.contains('@')) #set ($mediaReference = $services.model.serialize($services.model.resolveAttachment($mediaReference, $changeObject.reference))) #end #if ($videoFormats.contains($stringtool.substringAfterLast($mediaReference, '.'))) #set ($discard = $videoReferences.add($mediaReference)) #else #set ($discard = $screenshotReferences.add($mediaReference)) #end #end ## Handle screenshots #set ($useGallery = $useGallery && $screenshotReferences.size() > 0) #if ($useGallery) {{gallery width="420px" height="315px"}} #end #foreach($screenshotReference in $screenshotReferences) ## The reference is emitted into the reference part of an image link, so it must be escaped: left raw, a ## reference holding wiki syntax would close the link and have the rest of its value parsed on its own. #set ($screenshot = $services.rendering.escape($screenshotReference, 'xwiki/2.1')) #if ($useGallery) [[image:$screenshot]] #else #if ($foreach.count > 1) #end [[image:$screenshot||style="border:1px solid silver;"]] #end #end #if ($useGallery) {{/gallery}} #end ## Handle videos. ## When $alwaysDisplayScreenshots is true, display a video only if there are no screenshots to display, and only ## display the 1st video if there are more than one. #if (!$alwaysDisplayScreenshots || ($alwaysDisplayScreenshots && $screenshotReferences.size() == 0)) #if ($screenshotReferences.size() > 0) #end #if ($alwaysDisplayScreenshots && $videoReferences.size() > 0) #set ($computedVideoReferences = [$videoReferences.get(0)]) #else #set ($computedVideoReferences = $videoReferences) #end #foreach($videoReference in $computedVideoReferences) ## Same as for the screenshots above: the reference is emitted into a macro parameter value, so it must be ## escaped or a reference holding a quote would close the parameter and have what follows parsed on its own. #set ($video = $services.rendering.escape($videoReference, 'xwiki/2.1')) #if ($foreach.count > 1) #end {{html5video attachment="$video" width="420" /}} #end #end #end #end {{/velocity}}
